title: Corvid Token

sources.title: Boon of the Raven Queen
markers: | description = While wearing the amulet, the wearer's jump and flying speed increase by {{Dist|m=1.5}}, and they gain the {{Cond|Feather Fall}} condition. Feather Fall's effect will persist while the wearer is {{Cond|Polymorphed}} or [[Wild Shape|Wild-Shaped]].

sources.title: Polymorph: Dire Raven
markers: | description = Take the shape of a dire raven that can avoid attention and {{SmCond|Blinded|Blind}} enemies. It has {{hp|13}}.

summary: Jump and fly 5 ft farther, gain Feather Fall, and transform into a Dire Raven once per Long Rest.

fields.Boon of the Raven Queen: Jump distance and flying movement increase by 5 ft. Gain Feather Fall, which can persist through Polymorph and Wild Shape.
fields.Dire Raven: Action on yourself once per Long Rest. Become a Dire Raven with 13 HP until Long Rest.
fields.Raven actions: Use Beak Attack for melee Piercing damage, Rend Vision to Blind a target on a hit, or Fly for movement.
fields.Rend Vision: Action and melee attack. Base damage 1d6 + Dexterity modifier Piercing. A hit Blinds for 2 turns without a save.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
